name: Dyoplax
isnote: English Wikipedia lists Erpetosuchidae as tentative; the genus was earlier placed in Aetosauridae, Notochampsidae/Protosuchidae, Sphenosuchia and Crocodylomorpha.
sum: Dyoplax is an enigmatic pseudosuchian known from a natural cast of a nearly complete skeleton from the Carnian Schilfsandstein of Stuttgart, Germany.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A natural cast of a nearly complete skeleton, lacking only parts of the tail and limb bones, from the Schilfsandstein of Stuttgart, Germany.
biology: The sources consulted describe its classification history but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Fraas 1867

sources.text: Fraas, O. 1867. Dyoplax arenaceus, ein neuer Stuttgarter Keuper-Saurier. Jahreshefte des Vereins für vaterländische Naturkunde in Württemberg 23: 108–112.

Maisch, M. W., Matzke, A. T. and Rathgeber, T. 2013. Re-evaluation of the enigmatic archosaur Dyoplax arenaceus O. Fraas, 1867 [title shortened in the source list]. Neues Jahrbuch für Geologie und Paläontologie, Abhandlungen 267(3): 353–362.
Lucas, S. G., Wild, R. and Hunt, A. P. 1998. Dyoplax O. Fraas, a Triassic sphenosuchian from Germany. Stuttgarter Beiträge zur Naturkunde B 263: 1–13.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. English Wikipedia gives the early Carnian (about 228 Ma); the whole Carnian stage of the ICS chart is used here.
